role_title: Senior Product Manager - Product Adoption, Insights & AI

domain_problem_space_alignment.rationale: Directly sits at the intersection of Minesh's core strengths: designing KPI and dashboard frameworks for platform adoption, operational efficiency, and executive decision-making at Lowe's (lines 67, 77-81, 477-485) plus driving product adoption, user engagement, and retention across Byju's and Hype Marketing & Product Services (lines 147-151, 228-238).

technical_platform_ai_depth.rationale: B.Tech in Computer Science (lines 325-327) with direct experience in enterprise infrastructure/platform operations, KPI/telemetry dashboard development, and AI-driven workflow/operational systems at Lowe's India (lines 53-62, 67-70, 96-99, 464-467).

seniority_and_scope_match.rationale: Exceeds the 7+ years overall and 5+ years PM requirement (~11 years total experience, ~6 years in formal PM titles, currently Senior PM at Lowe's India). B.Tech CS meets the engineering degree requirement, and ongoing IIM Bangalore EGMP (lines 321-323) aligns with the preferred MBA/management credential.

measurable_impact_and_commercial_relevan.rationale: Strong measurable outcomes across platform reliability and adoption (99.99% reliability, 20% cycle time reduction, ~$10M revenue protection, $2M cost savings) and user conversion/adoption (35% conversion lift, 2.5L+ SQLs, 4.5+ product ratings).

stakeholder_and_leadership_complexity.rationale: Extensive track record partnering across Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Marketing/GTM, and VP/CXO leadership to drive alignment and governance (lines 65-71, 475-494).

location_work_mode_practical_constraints.rationale: Bangalore hybrid role matches candidate's Bangalore location with zero relocation friction.

six_dimension_summary.role_scope: Portfolio-wide strategy, roadmap, and execution for Product Adoption & Insights, customer health metrics, executive reporting, and AI-powered recommendations.
six_dimension_summary.seniority_alignment: Exact match for Senior Product Manager (requires 7+ yrs total / 5+ yrs PM; candidate brings ~11 yrs total / ~6 yrs formal PM + IIM-B EGMP).
six_dimension_summary.product_discipline: Platform Adoption, Analytics, Telemetry Insights & AI Product Management — directly aligned with candidate's KPI dashboard, platform adoption, and AI workflow background.
six_dimension_summary.domain_relevance: High relevance combining enterprise infrastructure/platform operations (Lowe's India) with product-led adoption and customer lifecycle analytics (Byju's, Hype).
six_dimension_summary.leadership_expectations: Cross-functional alignment across Product, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, Engineering, and Corporate Strategy — directly supported by executive governance and GTM/ops alignment experience.
six_dimension_summary.evidence_strength: Very high direct evidence across almost all required and preferred qualifications.

key_strengths: Led KPI and dashboard development for operational decision-making at Lowe's India, tracking platform adoption, incident resolution, cost savings, and operational efficiency across enterprise platforms (lines 67, 77-81).

Designed and launched AI-driven procurement/catalog workflows and automated recovery systems at Lowe's India, delivering 20% faster cycle times, ~$10M annual revenue protection, and $2M cost savings (lines 84-99).
Strong educational and executive communication pedigree: B.Tech CS (Manipal), IIM Bangalore EGMP (ongoing), and monthly VP/CXO business review leadership (lines 321-327, 477-485).
positioning_angle: Position as an Enterprise Platform & AI Strategy Senior Product Manager who combines deep infrastructure/reliability operations and KPI/adoption dashboard governance at Lowe's India with full-funnel product adoption, user engagement, and GTM execution. Highlight how AI-assisted workflows and agentic operational insights translate telemetry and adoption data into measurable customer value and retention.
red_flags_and_gaps: B2B enterprise Customer Success / Renewals telemetry (specifically for hybrid-cloud infrastructure software like Nutanix) is adjacent to Lowe's internal enterprise platform adoption tracking and Byju's/Hype customer lifecycle analytics.

Ensure CV bridges enterprise platform KPI dashboards and AI workflow automation to customer health and adoption insights without claiming prior ownership of Nutanix-style B2B SaaS renewal/telemetry tooling.
